old_panels: Preserve all prior results. Exclude normalized molecular parents in all previously selected panels for each target and the crystal ligand.

split.parent_key: RDKit Cleanup, Uncharger, canonical tautomer, remove stereochemistry; used only for split exclusion, never to alter docking molecules

eligibility: Same supplied DUD-E conformers, one fragment, 12-55 heavy atoms, supported elements, finite 3D coordinates. Retain preparation failures; no replacement or optional stopping.
receptor_audit: Inventory residues including cofactors encoded as ATOM; check heavy coordinates, nearest-heavy polar-H attachments, donor/acceptor typing and binding-site proximity. Source-state preparation maps generic HIS to HID/HIE/HIP from source polar-H attachments before the existing Meeko recipe; preserve explicit residue states and cofactors. Never optimize a residue state using evaluation scores.
crystal_site_box: Center at heavy-atom crystal bounding-box midpoint; each side max(20 A, crystal span + 12 A). This defines a local-site diagnostic, not universal cavity coverage. No evaluation-ligand coordinates used.
redocking_gate: At least 2/3 seeds have top-ranked symmetry-corrected heavy-atom RMSD <= 2 A, without alignment. Require unchanged ligand graph and all jobs complete.
selection_rule: After all development and crystal jobs finish, retain configurations with complete development results, development AUC >= 0.75, EF10 >= 1.5 and the redocking gate. Choose highest development AUC; exact ties choose lower exhaustiveness then protocol order. If none qualify, do not inspect heldout scores for that target. Record the chosen configuration hash before heldout docking.
ef10_ties: Fractional occupancy at the score cutoff, independent of job completion order.
limitations: Small development set may overfit; only fresh heldout results support qualification. No guarantee of obtaining 2-3 successes. No failed target replacement, retrospective threshold changes, or distributed-run comparisons in this diagnostic.
